method: Production game; original seeded autonomous battles; only pause/speed/selection/camera/renderer UI controls. No scripted orders, targets, shots or demo clock. Videos are uninterrupted; separate held-phase PNGs pause the same real matches at observed states, wait for composition and verify the actual displayed frame.
